Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::orderItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		Item.allInstances()->exists(i: Item|i.Barcode = barcode)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries@pre->forAll(e: OrderEntry|self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(e)) and
		OrderEntry.allInstances()->exists(oe: OrderEntry|oe.oclIsNew() and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(oe) and
		Item.allInstances()->exists(i: Item|i.Barcode = barcode and
		oe.Item = i and
		oe.Quantity = quantity and
		oe.SubAmount = quantity*i.OrderPrice))
}
